RIGHT SET AND RIGHT ORDER on the full set. loop_slack's P3 was measuring a subset that
had been conditioned on the model's own tail, which made the ordering look worse than
it is.
THE REAL LIMITATION IS RECALL, not ordering: precision 77% against recall 36%.
When this model calls a gene costly it is usually right; it simply cannot see most of
what cells depend on, because 285 of those dependencies are outside
metabolism or outside the reactions Human-GEM carries. That is a coverage problem with
a named gene list, not an ordering problem.
NOTE T2's WEAKNESS: the |null| 95th percentile is 0.4923 on 158 genes, so
the ordering test only just clears a very wide band and should not be leaned on.
